entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: Orc warrior of Tarkir; Abzan krumar in the current timeline (formerly of Kolaghan's clan) and Anafenza's krumar commander and adoptive brother in the original timeline.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Abzan leader who became Khan; Gvar's kin.

entities.name: Oret
entities.description: Anafenza's cousin who in the original timeline hired the Sultai to destroy her family; loyal cousin in the current timeline.

entities.name: Kwaro
entities.description: Captain of the guard present at Anafenza's ceremony.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragonlord whose clan Gvar belonged to in the current timeline.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: Clan Gvar was born into in the original timeline.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: Clan whose raiders attacked Anafenza's fortress.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Gvar tries to befriend young Anafenza but she refuses to acknowledge his kinship.
events.quote: Gvar attempted to be friends with Anafenza, calling her cousin

events.summary: A Sultai raiding party topples the rolling fortress; Anafenza and Gvar survive and flee into the desert.
events.quote: A pair of the mastodons toppled the entire fortress

events.summary: Anafenza and Gvar kill the pursuing Abzan traitors; one admits Oret hired the Sultai.
events.quote: it had been Anafenza's cousin Oret who had hired the Sultai and staged the attack

events.summary: At the ceremony for Khan Anafenza, Gvar forces Oret to his knees and she disowns him.
events.quote: Gvar stepped up and forced Oret to his knees.

events.summary: In 4559 AR Gvar, as Kolaghan's whipmaster, attacks the Abzan; Anafenza uses spirit necromancy to kill all his warriors.
events.quote: she killed all of Gvar's warriors

events.summary: By 4564 Gvar has rejoined the Abzan as a krumar captain.
events.quote: he had joined the Abzan again as a krumar

relations.quote: Gvar served as her krumar commander.

relations.note: called her brother in the original timeline
relations.quote: Then she bid her brother Gvar to show the traitor out.

relations.note: betrayed her in the original timeline
relations.quote: the man who had betrayed her, murdered her entire family, and destroyed her home
He served as the dragon's whipmaster
